tools.name: create_bot
tools.title: Create a meeting bot
tools.description: Send a MeetStream bot to a Zoom / Google Meet / Microsoft Teams meeting (or schedule it with join_at). Returns bot_id and (when a transcription provider is set) transcript_id. Set callback_url to receive lifecycle webhooks.

meeting_link.description: Full meeting URL (Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams)

bot_name.description: Display name in the meeting (default "MeetStream Bot")

record_video.description: Record video as well as audio. Defaults to false: send audio-only unless the user asked for video. Transcripts, summaries, diarization and speaker timelines all work without it

video_layout.description: With record_video: 'speaker_view' (default here, follows the active speaker) or 'grid_view' (composited mosaic of everyone). Only pass grid_view when the user asked for grid or gallery view. The REST API itself defaults to grid_view, so this is always sent explicitly. Google Meet, Teams and Zoom only

transcription_provider.description: Post-call: deepgram (default choice), assemblyai, sarvam (Indic), meetstream, jigsawstack, meeting_captions (native). Real-time: deepgram_streaming, assemblyai_streaming. Streaming providers produce no post-call transcript (no transcription.processed webhook).

language.description: Language in the provider's format (deepgram "en", assemblyai "en_us", sarvam "en-IN")

callback_url.description: HTTPS webhook URL for lifecycle events

join_at.description: Schedule a future join, ISO 8601 e.g. 2026-07-02T15:00:00Z

bot_message.description: Chat message posted when the bot joins

bot_image_url.description: PUBLIC image URL for the bot avatar (raw base64 is rejected)

retention_hours.description: Data retention window in hours (default 720, i.e. 30 days)

separate_video_streams.description: Capture one video file per participant. Opt-in only: leave unset unless the user explicitly asked for per-participant video

agent_config_id.description: Attach a MIA conversational AI agent

live_transcript_webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for live transcript chunks

custom_attributes.description: String key/values echoed back in every webhook

idempotency_key.description: UUID for safe retries (a retry returns the original bot, HTTP 507, no double charge)

google_login_domain.description: Google Meet signed-in join: a Google Workspace domain already registered for signed-in bots on this account

teams_login_domain.description: Microsoft Teams signed-in join: a domain already registered for signed-in Teams bots on this account. The bot uses that Microsoft account's name and picture, and each account runs one bot at a time

sign_in_email.description: With google_login_domain or teams_login_domain: pin the join to one registered account instead of any available one

strict_email.description: With sign_in_email: true (API default) fails if that account is busy; false falls back to another available account

zoom_zak_url.description: Zoom signed-in join: HTTPS URL on your server that returns a fresh ZAK token

zoom_obf_url.description: Zoom on-behalf-of join: HTTPS URL on your server that returns a fresh OBF token (the user must already be in the meeting)

tools.name: list_bots
tools.title: List bots
tools.description: List all bots on the account (paginated: bots[], hasNextPage, nextCursor).

tools.name: get_bot_status
tools.title: Get bot status
tools.description: Current bot status. Values: Joining, InWaitingRoom, InMeeting, Recording, Leaving, Stopped, NotAllowed, Denied, Error, Done.

tools.name: get_bot_detail
tools.title: Get bot detail
tools.description: Full session metadata: platform, duration, timings, status timeline, transcript_id (canonical source), caption_file (for meeting_captions provider), original request payload.

tools.name: get_bot_summary
tools.title: Get AI meeting summary
tools.description: MeetStream has no built-in meeting summary: this tool only says so. To summarize a meeting, call get_transcript (wait=true) and write the summary from its segments.

tools.name: remove_bot
tools.title: Remove bot from meeting
tools.description: Make the bot leave an active meeting now. Recorded data is kept.

tools.name: delete_bot_data
tools.title: Delete bot data (permanent)
tools.description: Permanently delete a bot's audio, video and transcripts. Irreversible. Fires a data_deletion webhook.

confirm.description: Must be true to perform the permanent deletion

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Fetch a bot's transcript by bot_id. Resolves transcript_id automatically (it is NOT in webhooks) via /detail → /transcriptions. With wait=true, polls until the transcript is ready or timeout_seconds passes. Segments have `speaker` and `transcript` fields.

wait.description: Poll until the transcript is ready (up to timeout_seconds)

raw.description: Return raw provider output instead of processed segments

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.title: List transcription runs
tools.description: All transcription runs for a bot: transcript_id, provider, status, presigned download_urls (valid 1h).

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.title: Run / re-run transcription
tools.description: Start a (re-)transcription of a bot's recorded audio with a chosen post-call provider. Useful to try a different provider or language after the meeting.

tools.name: get_media_urls
tools.title: Get recording URLs
tools.description: Presigned S3 URLs for recorded media. kind=audio (valid 1h), video (valid 10min), audio_streams / video_streams (per-participant; require separate_*_streams at creation), screenshots.

tools.name: get_participants
tools.title: Get participants
tools.description: Participants detected in the meeting (displayName, fullName, status, stream ids).

tools.name: get_chats
tools.title: Get in-meeting chat
tools.description: Chat messages captured during the meeting.

tools.name: get_speaker_timeline
tools.title: Get speaker timeline
tools.description: Who spoke and when (chunk timeline with speaker ids/names).

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.title: Send chat message into the meeting
tools.description: Post a chat message into the live meeting through the bot.

tools.name: send_image
tools.title: Show an image in the meeting
tools.description: Display an image/GIF as the bot's video frame. img_url must be PUBLIC.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: Upcoming events from the Google Calendars connected to this MeetStream account.

tools.name: schedule_calendar_bot
tools.title: Schedule / unschedule a calendar bot
tools.description: action=schedule sends a bot to a specific calendar event; action=unschedule removes it.

tools.name: webhook_events_guide
tools.title: Webhook events guide
tools.description: Reference for MeetStream webhook events: envelope shape (event and bot_event), the two-layer bot.stopped terminal model, status codes, and streaming-provider caveats.

tools.name: top_up_link
tools.title: Top up credits
tools.description: Link to the MeetStream dashboard billing page, where the account owner adds prepaid credits. Use it when create_bot fails with 'Low credits please recharge', or when the user asks how to add credits or pay. Needs no arguments and makes no API call.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Credit balance
tools.description: The prepaid MeetStream credit balance of this account, in USD (bots bill per hour from it). Postpaid (invoice) accounts get balance_usd null. Use it when the user asks how much credit is left, or before sending many bots. To add credits, use top_up_link.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List voice agents
tools.description: List the voice agent (MIA) configurations of this account, and mia_managed: whether MeetStream's inbuilt keys are on (enabled) and the providers and models they cover per section. Prices are not returned; the dashboard agent editor shows the per-hour rate. If enabled is false, create agents with the user's own provider keys.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.title: Get a voice agent
tools.description: One voice agent (MIA) configuration by id. Key values are redacted.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.title: Create a voice agent
tools.description: Create a voice agent (MIA) configuration, then send it with create_bot agent_config_id (never with the bridge sockets). Use this for flow 3 (MeetStream hosts the agent) or flow 2b (the user's own agent: model.provider local_agent). Pipeline mode needs model, transcriber and voice; realtime mode needs only model and runs on the user's own provider key (inbuilt keys are pipeline only). If the API says MeetStream-managed keys are not available, say inbuilt keys are not on for the account yet and continue with the user's own keys; do not retry the same request. local_agent: the pairing token is saved in the dashboard only (Integrations → Models → Local agent); never ask for it. Warn about prompt injection and use the lowest access level. Provider keys: prefer key_source "meetstream" (inbuilt keys, pipeline mode only) or keys the user saved in the dashboard under Integrations; never ask the user to paste a provider key into chat. Key values are never echoed back. Docs: https://docs.meetstream.ai/guides/mia/pricing-and-keys

model.description: LLM (pipeline) or realtime model. Pipeline providers: openai, anthropic, google, xai, local_agent (the user's own agent through the MeetStream Agent Kit). Realtime: openai, google, xai. system_prompt is required except for local_agent.
Required in pipeline mode, except with local_agent

voice.description: Realtime models with a built-in voice

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

local_agent.description: Required when provider is local_agent. The pairing token is never part of it: the user saves it in the dashboard only

url.description: The user's bridge (tunnel) public https:// address

voice.description: Text-to-speech (pipeline mode). For example provider openai, model tts-1, voice_id nova

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

transcriber.description: Speech-to-text (pipeline mode). For example provider deepgram, model nova-3

language.description: For example en or es; multi or auto detects the language

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

agent.description: Behaviour, for example tools (current_time, weather_now, screen), chat_input, quiet_actions, speak_only_when_asked (pipeline only), desktop, interruption settings. See https://docs.meetstream.ai/guides/mia/mia-api-guide

tools.name: update_agent
tools.title: Update a voice agent
tools.description: Change a saved voice agent (MIA) configuration. Send agent_config_id and only the parts to change; each section you send replaces that section. Changing mode needs the full configuration (agent_name, model, and in pipeline mode transcriber and voice). Bots already in a meeting keep the old settings: use update_live_agent for those. Provider keys: prefer key_source "meetstream" (inbuilt keys, pipeline mode only) or keys the user saved in the dashboard under Integrations; never ask the user to paste a provider key into chat. Key values are never echoed back.

model.description: LLM (pipeline) or realtime model. Pipeline providers: openai, anthropic, google, xai, local_agent (the user's own agent through the MeetStream Agent Kit). Realtime: openai, google, xai. system_prompt is required except for local_agent.
Required in pipeline mode, except with local_agent

voice.description: Realtime models with a built-in voice

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

local_agent.description: Required when provider is local_agent. The pairing token is never part of it: the user saves it in the dashboard only

url.description: The user's bridge (tunnel) public https:// address

voice.description: Text-to-speech (pipeline mode). For example provider openai, model tts-1, voice_id nova

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

transcriber.description: Speech-to-text (pipeline mode). For example provider deepgram, model nova-3

language.description: For example en or es; multi or auto detects the language

key_source.description: Pipeline mode only. "meetstream" = MeetStream's inbuilt key for this section (send no api_key). "user" or no value = the user's own key saved in the dashboard under Integrations

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.title: Delete a voice agent (permanent)
tools.description: Permanently delete a voice agent (MIA) configuration. Bots already running with it finish their meeting. Confirm with the user first.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete the configuration

tools.name: check_local_agent
tools.title: Test a local agent connection
tools.description: Test the bridge of a voice agent that uses model.provider local_agent (the dashboard's Test connection). Returns local_agent.status (ok, no_token, token_rejected, login_expired, not_installed, unreachable, bad_url, not_local_agent) and the fix. The pairing token is saved in the dashboard only; never ask for it.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.title: Take a meeting screenshot
tools.description: Capture the meeting from a bot that is in it (send_command screenshot). Google Meet and Microsoft Teams; Zoom bots that join through the customer's Zoom app (Meeting SDK) do not support it. Get the image with get_media_urls kind=screenshots. Shares the 30 commands per minute per bot limit.

tools.name: list_calendar_connections
tools.title: List calendar connections
tools.description: The Google and Outlook calendar accounts connected for calendar bots, with the status of each. Tokens are never returned. To connect a calendar, the user follows https://docs.meetstream.ai/guides/calendar-integration/calendar-integration-api or uses the dashboard; never ask for OAuth secrets in chat.

tools.name: disconnect_calendar
tools.title: Disconnect a calendar (permanent)
tools.description: Disconnect calendar accounts. By default (purge_events true) the account's synced events and the bots scheduled from them are deleted too. Without provider, every connected account is disconnected. With several accounts, pass provider and account_id (from list_calendar_connections). Confirm with the user first.

account_id.description: The connected account's email address; needs provider

purge_events.description: Also delete the synced events and their scheduled bots (default true)
